description: A purple short-sleeve shirt lies on a bed with a light green sheet, against a brown headboard and a wall near a door. The left hand lifts and spreads the shirt open while the right hand comes in to help hold it briefly as a two-hand object, then the shirt is laid flat; the left hand smooths and pulls the bottom edge downward, and the right hand folds one side inward, then the other, before folding the shirt over into a compact rectangle and releasing it.
